slides.quote: The feedback isn't the problem. **The channel is.**
slides.context: Fans already tell clubs what they think every week. It just arrives as boos and angry threads.

slides.quote: Every founding team needs someone who **thinks like a business analyst**, even if nobody has the title.

slides.title: 6½ years before his first title. Today he'd get 6½ months.
